_comment: studentId -> GET /api/student/marks response shape. 3 past graded academic years + the current in-progress term (NotScore="1", grades null). Students with retakeStatus (see students.json) carry a failing record for one subject plus either a later passing retake ("resolved") or a currently-in-progress retake ("in-progress") — same CurriculumID, a NEW ScheduleStudyUnitID. Dual-program students (secondaryDept in students.json) carry extra records tagged with their secondary StudyProgramID.
